'''Sai-Ani Kannu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] who worked as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kannu met with a [[Human/Legends|Human]] in the bar [[Crater's]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], and the man hired Kannu to protect eleven individuals in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] who had contracts against their lives.
